shadows.name: status-inner-ring
shadows.purpose: Separates the status fill from its outline without adding elevation.

motion.name: state-ease-out
motion.purpose: Color, border, and press feedback only; reduced to 0.01ms for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Applies settings or confirms the page's primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); cursor: pointer; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), border-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--accent-hover); background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supports search and secondary confirmation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), border-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--surface-active); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Collects places, coordinates, and numeric configuration values.
components.html: <label class="ds-field" for="ds-place">Place or address<input id="ds-place" type="search" placeholder="City or airport"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-sm); color: var(--text); font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 1rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Offers a short set of mutually exclusive radar values.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--border); } .ds-segmented label { position: relative; display: flex; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-segmented span { display: flex; flex: 1; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-muted); font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: var(--space-sm); } .ds-segmented input:checked + span { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-segmented input:focus-visible + span { position: relative; z-index: 1; outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Settings Switch
components.description: Toggles an optional display feature with plain-language supporting copy.
components.css: .ds-switch { min-height: 44px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-md); align-items: center; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-switch > input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-switch-track { position: relative; width: 3rem; height: 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-switch-track::after { position: absolute; top: 0.25rem; left: 0.25rem; width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-muted); content: ''; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track::after { background: var(--accent-ink); transform: translateX(1.2rem); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-switch-copy { display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; } .ds-switch-copy strong { font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-switch-copy small { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Option Disclosure
components.description: Reveals optional settings without turning each group into a card.
components.html:
Aircraft labels

Route and aircraft details are optional.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { min-width: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-md) 0; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 750; } .ds-disclosure[open] summary { color: var(--text); } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { color: var(--accent); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-disclosure div { padding: var(--space-sm) 0 var(--space-xl); } .ds-disclosure p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Validation Notice
components.description: Reports validation errors with a symbol, outline, and tinted surface.
components.html: Check the highlighted settings and try again.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; gap: var(--space-md); align-items: flex-start; margin: 0; padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg); border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--danger-surface); color: var(--danger); font: 650 0.9375rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-notice::before { flex: 0 0 auto; content: '!'; font-weight: 900; }

components.name: Radar Status
components.description: Shows appliance readiness as a compact instrument row.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; gap: var(--space-md); align-items: center; padding: var(--space-lg) 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-mark { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; border: 2px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--canvas); } .ds-status div { display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; } .ds-status strong { font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-status div span { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview:
Plane Radar borrows the clarity of a civilian aviation instrument, then softens it for a dedicated appliance at home. The surface is dark because it belongs beside an always-on radar display, but the restrained green guidance color and generous touch targets keep configuration approachable rather than theatrical.

Information is arranged as a calm sequence of structural rules, native controls, and progressive disclosure. Identity appears in the radar mark and compact masthead; everything below serves location and display configuration. The system explicitly rejects generic SaaS dashboards, military command software, neon hacker tooling, and novelty retro terminals.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layers with one rare guidance-green accent.
Flat structural separation instead of decorative cards.
Familiar native controls with strong focus and touch affordances.
Mobile-first flow that becomes a two-column console at desktop widths.

rules.name: The One Guidance Color Rule
rules.body: Guidance Green marks an action, selection, readiness, or focus state. It is not decoration.

rules.name: The Native Instrument Rule
rules.body: Use the system stack everywhere; hierarchy comes from weight, size, and spacing, never a decorative display face.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with tone, spacing, or a 1px rule. Do not float configuration in decorative cards.

dos: **Do** keep primary touch targets at least 44px high and keyboard focus visible with the 3px `focus` outline.
**Do** use native form semantics, labels, fieldsets, and `details` disclosure before inventing a custom interaction.
**Do** use Guidance Green only for actions, selections, readiness, and focus.
**Do** preserve the single-column phone flow, paired fields above 34rem, and the location/preferences split above 52rem.
**Do** use spacing, tonal surfaces, and 1px rules to make hierarchy obvious.
**Do** keep prose to 68ch or less and wrap provider/privacy explanations naturally.
donts: **Don't** make the interface resemble a generic SaaS dashboard.
**Don't** make it feel like military command software.
**Don't** use neon hacker tooling or novelty retro-terminal styling.
**Don't** introduce decorative cards, nested cards, or identical card grids.
**Don't** add excessive instrumentation or visual effects that compete with configuration.
**Don't** use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, glassmorphism, or decorative motion.
**Don't** use full-saturation accents on inactive states or introduce a second decorative accent color.
**Don't** replace familiar native controls with invented affordances.
